cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, Brooklyn, New York, 1964; (Andrew Crispo Gallery, Inc., New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1980; (Martha Parrish & James Reinish, Inc., New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946. . . . On backing: In graphite by O'Keeffe 'Grey and White' – 25. Initials in circle" [not verified]. Whitney Archive indicates, "Grey and white abstraction. Probably in 1926 exhibition of which we have no catalogue." This and other paintings were reproduced as advertising posters by Cheney Silks in the 1920s: see cat. nos. 479A, 480, 480A, and Appendix II, nos. 79–81. Orientation in Abiquiú Notebooks differs (upside down), but publication of image in Cheney Silks advertisement verifies orientation, see cat. no. 479A. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Grey and White

description: A series of overlapping, diagonal forms in white and gray resemble folds of fabric. Along the top edge of the canvas, undulating lines run diagonally to the image's top right edge.
title: Grey and White
